title: CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series Features The Integration and Coordination Center (ICC)
bodyHtml: The May CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series featured The Integration and Coordination Center (ICC), with a presentation on "Sustainability and Evaluation Within the Common Fund Data Ecosystem." If you couldn't make it, check out the webinar recording on YouTube, featuring Swathi Thaker, Jake Chen, Casey Greene, and Caitlin Ree.
summary: The May CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series featured The Integration and Coordination Center (ICC), with a presentation on "Sustainability and Evaluation Within the Common Fund Data Ecosystem."
